scope: Vaporize runs a generated Xcode app test action from Pkl and project/scheme authority without a SwiftPM app-project requirement.
commands: vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test xcode --artifact app --pkl-path <app>/project.pkl --xcode-project <app>/<app>.xcodeproj --scheme <scheme> --configuration debug --xcode-destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' --xcode-build-setting CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
toolingBoundary: The Pkl/Xcode app-test source implementation is syntax-checked. Its owned SwiftPM source-test lane is presently blocked in the package resolver, so this scheme does not claim a source test or installed-runtime pass until that separate stall is resolved.
claims: An app test must use the Xcode execution authority.
A Pkl-authored app may be tested without Package.swift or SwiftPM editable-dependency preparation.
The tool does not install an app or imply release, terminal evidence, or human approval.
